name: scportal-hub
description: Single-Cell Portal Hub - Unified platform combining iAODE Dataset Browser and LAIOR Benchmarking Dashboard

scripts.pregenerate: npm run validate:router-data && npm run build:router-assets
scripts.typecheck:router: tsc --noEmit --strict --allowImportingTsExtensions --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext app/core/router/types.ts app/core/router/ids.ts app/core/router/normalize.ts app/core/router/gower.ts app/core/router/shrinkage.ts app/core/router/constraints.ts app/core/router/pareto.ts app/core/router/random.ts app/core/router/bootstrap.ts app/core/router/outranking.ts app/core/router/confidence.ts app/core/router/release-digest.ts app/core/router/recommend.ts app/core/router/explain.ts app/core/router/index.ts app/core/config/types.ts app/core/config/templates.ts app/core/config/schema.ts app/core/config/serialize.ts app/core/config/compiler.ts
scripts.check:router: npm run validate:router-data && npm run check:router-boundaries && npm run test:router-config && npm run test:config-python && npm run typecheck
scripts.validate: npm run validate:router-data && npm run validate:public-graph
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:router && npm run test:site && npm run validate:public-graph && npm run generate && npm run check:static-routes && npm run check:rendered-public-graph
